creator: Claude Code (Anthropic, claude-sonnet-5-5) for Tien Nghich 2D
rights: Original note score, voice synthesis and arrangement created for the project. All audible input is generated from the supplied score and additive-oscillator/FM/noise patch. No recordings, samples, soundfont or generative-audio model.
render: From the checkout root, run python -I -B assets/audio/bgm_boss_trial/render.py <output.wav> with CPython 3.14.5 and NumPy 2.5.5 (tools/.venvs/project/bin/python). The output parent directory must exist.
patch: PCG64 seed 7121. Growl: twelve-partial additive voice with a 5.1 Hz vibrato and seeded grit, fast swell. Drums: a pitch-falling skin boom (52 Hz) and a high-passed noise rim crack (tak), panned. Struck bronze: four inharmonic partials (1, 2.76, 5.4, 8.93) with separate decays. Seeded noise risers on cut bars. 1.5 s seeded-noise reverb applied by circular FFT convolution, wet 0.3, so tails cross the loop boundary. Events and releases wrap modulo the loop. Master gain 1.38, nearest-even PCM16 quantization without dither.
tuning: D with a flat second (D Eb F G A); growl A1-Eb2 (MIDI 33-39), bronze D4-Eb5 (MIDI 62-75), A4 = 440 Hz
register_note: Measured mono energy share: below 100 Hz -1.1 dB, 100-450 Hz -8.7 dB, 450-1600 Hz -11.9 dB, 1.6-5 kHz -17.3 dB, above 5 kHz -20.5 dB of total. Low skin drum and growl carry the bed; bronze hits sit above and avoid the first beat of every bar, and the six cut bars leave the boss tell room.
loop_use: One loop serves all three Tram Tien Dai rounds; the game restarts or continues it, no per-round variant exists.

breath_bars.note: Bars 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24 (1-based) are cut bars: one drum beat and a noise riser, no bronze. They leave a gap in the pulse where sfx_tell_boss and the adjudicator's tell can sit.

loop_units: sample frames per channel, half-open [loopStart, loopEnd)
onset_tail: The reverb and drum tails of the last bar are still sounding across the final frame and continue into bar 1; frame 0 equals the continuation of frame 2645999.

verification.rebuild: Two independent render processes wrote to separate empty directories (together with the other bed and the eight SFX). Master WAVs, all SFX WAVs and the SFX ledger matched (diff -r).
verification.meter: FFmpeg 8.1.2 ebur128 (peak=true) on the master WAV; not the pinned 6.1.1 build, which this machine lacks. Re-measure on the pinned build in the packing step.
